unsupported: The family-owned gallery now occupies a fifth-floor showroom and design studio at 8219 Leesburg Pike in Tysons Corner.

The company does not manufacture furniture; instead it represents more than 40 American furniture makers — among them heritage brands such as Harden and Henredon — and curates a selection of furniture, lighting, accessories, rugs, and custom window treatments for immediate purchase or made-to-order delivery.
